purpose: Captures public model-card source metadata, publisher namespace, task shape, public URL, license posture, privacy boundary, and storage policy without storing model weights or private training data.
Represents derived candidate primitives such as label schemas, task definitions, eval harness seeds, limitations, and replacement routes.
Links model IDs, publishers, task shapes, domain signals, datasets, benchmarks, and eval concepts into reusable graph entities.
Connects each model-derived primitive to its model, publisher, workflow, domain, and dataset/evaluation context.
Groups equivalent candidate primitives by source model ID, task shape, content hash, and primitive type before promotion.
Assigns hierarchical, domain, scope, task-shape, and generated primitive labels for hybrid search and filtering.
Stores generated dimensions such as training context count, eval context count, label count, replacement route count, weight-download status, and publication readiness.
Creates embedding work items with deterministic text hashes and embedding buckets for later vector generation.
Emits keyword, vector, graph, facet, quality, and cost index rows for model-derived primitive discovery.
Routes healthcare, legal, privacy, security, safety, and other high-impact primitives to curator or domain review before promotion.
